jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Field-based

As a Peripheral Vascular Field Clinical Specialist at Stryker, you will help transform the lives of patients suffering from venous and other vascular diseases together with our customers. This is a vital role in supporting our customers with advanced training, clinical expertise, and real-time procedural support to help us achieve our mission of making healthcare better.

Ideal North New Jersey locations: Paramus, Westwood, Ridgewood, Bergen County, and Ramsey

What you will do:

• Provide exceptional hands-on training and education to physicians on device handling, implantation, and troubleshooting for Inari products.

• Lead and facilitate in-service training sessions in clinical environments.

• Partner with our Account Managers to identify opportunities and drive therapy adoption.

• Be ready for on-call support for urgent clinical needs that can occur outside of standard business hours to ensure our commitment to our customers.

What you need:

• Associate’s degree in nursing or clinical field (ie. Cath lab); Bachelor’s degree preferred

• 3+ years of clinical experience in medical device space

• Deep understanding of cardiovascular anatomy, physiology, and pathology preferred

• OR experience with advanced clinical procedure

• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities

• Valid driver’s license

Sales Base + commission: $ 130,000.00 and may be eligible to earn commission and/or bonuses + benefits.

Travel Percentage: 50%

Stryker Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Stryker is an EO employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability.

Stryker Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

Stryker is driven to work together with our customers to make healthcare better. Employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required, depending on customer requirements, to obtain the COVID-19 vaccination as an essential function of their role.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Flessibilità del lavoro: Come Specialista Clinica Campo Vascolare periferico a Stryker, vi aiuterà a trasformare la vita di pazienti affetti da malattie venose e altre vascolari insieme ai nostri clienti. Questo è un ruolo vitale nel sostenere i nostri clienti con formazione avanzata, competenza clinica e supporto procedurale in tempo reale per aiutarci a raggiungere la nostra missione di migliorare la salute. Luoghi ideali nel New Jersey: Paramus, Westwood, Ridgewood, Bergen County e Ramsey Cosa farai:
• Fornire un'eccezionale formazione e formazione pratica ai medici sulla gestione dei dispositivi, l'impianto e la risoluzione dei problemi per i prodotti Inari.
• Guidare e facilitare sessioni di formazione in servizio in ambienti clinici.
• Partner con i nostri Account Manager per identificare le opportunità e l'adozione della terapia.
• Sii pronto per il supporto on-call per esigenze cliniche urgenti che possono verificarsi al di fuori delle ore di lavoro standard per garantire il nostro impegno per i nostri clienti. Cosa ti serve:
• Laurea in allattamento o in campo clinico (cioè laboratorio di Cath); laurea preferito
• 3+ anni di esperienza clinica nello spazio dei dispositivi medici
• La profonda comprensione dell'anatomia cardiovascolare, della fisiologia e della patologia ha preferito
• O esperienza con procedura clinica avanzata
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e di costruzione di relazioni
• Licenza valida del conducente Vendite Base + commissione: $ 130.000,00 e possono essere idonei a guadagnare commissioni e/o bonus + benefici. Percentuale di viaggio: 50% Stryker Corporation è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. I candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, etnia, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, disabilità, o status veterano protetto. Stryker è un datore di lavoro EO – M/F/Veteran/Disability. Stryker Corporation non dimetterà o in qualsiasi altro modo discriminare contro i dipendenti o i candidati perché hanno chiesto circa, discusso, o divulgato la propria paga o la paga di un altro dipendente o richiedente. Tuttavia, i dipendenti che hanno accesso alle informazioni di compensazione di altri dipendenti o candidati come parte delle loro funzioni di lavoro essenziali non possono divulgare la paga di altri dipendenti o candidati a persone che non hanno altrimenti accesso a informazioni di compensazione, a meno che la divulgazione non sia (a) in risposta a una denuncia formale o ad un'accusa, (b) in avanzamento di un'indagine, procedimento, udienza o azione, compresa un'indagine condotta dal datore di lavoro, o (c) coerente con l'informazione legale del contraente. Stryker è guidato a lavorare insieme ai nostri clienti per migliorare la salute. I dipendenti e i nuovi assunti nei ruoli di vendita e di campo che richiedono l'accesso ai conti del cliente in funzione del lavoro possono essere richiesti, a seconda delle esigenze del cliente, per ottenere la vaccinazione COVID-19 come funzione essenziale del loro ruolo.

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Industrialisierung neuer Produkte in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering und Advanced Operations

• Sie bringen sich aktiv in kontinuierliche Verbesserungs‑ und Lean‑Initiativen ein, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen um

Das zeichnet Sie aus
Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Mechanik, Zerspanung, Polymechanik oder vergleichbar)

• Mindestens 5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Einrichten- und Einfahren von CNC-Maschinen, inklusive Problem- und Ursachen Diagnose, idealerweise im Langdreh‑Prozess

• Sehr gute mechanische und prozesstechnische Kenntnisse in der CNC‑Bearbeitung

• Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte Verantwortungsbereitschaft

• Erfahrung in einem produzierenden Unternehmen in der Medizintechnik Branche

jobs.title: Senior Staff Microbiologist
jobs.description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

​ Senior Staff Microbiologist - Hybrid

**12 month fixed term contract**

Not lab based

Position requirements
The Senior Staff Microbiologist will be primarily responsible for providing technical input into the sterility compliance of Stryker's product in accordance with relevant regulatory requirements and standards for medical devices, at a muti site / global level. The staff microbiologist will oversee and act as subject matter expert / technical lead in all areas of microbiology and ensuring sustained levels of sterility compliance.

Position Requirements
Will work within the microbiology team, with responsibility to ensure effective and efficient sterility practices, which includes, but not limited to the following:

• Oversight of environmental & utility monitoring, bioburden and endotoxin testing practices and procedures, creating alignment and standardization across multi sites.

• Execution, review and approval of Gamma and Ethylene Oxide sterilization validations and re-qualifications in line with relevant BS EN ISO standards. Assessment of sterility supplier validation.

• Interpreting sampling and monitoring data, applying statistical and analysis techniques, to determine control and trending. Indentifies and initiates when to take action.

• Lead technical input to NC and CAPA resolution within the Microbiology group and across multiple business units / sites. Strong competency in in assessment of effectivity and resulting sterility compliance. Review and approval of CAPA.

• Act as technical lead for microbiology in cross functional groups including product and process issues, rootcausing, projects, initiatives and other business critical forums..

• Subject Matter Expert, audit and review of Supplier quality activities with critical vendors in area of microbiology.

• Review and approval of sterilisation validations and re-qualifications in line with relevant BS EN ISO standards. Assessment of sterility supplier validation.

• Continually identifies opportunity for stabilization of trends, statistical control of processes to allow cost saving.

• Mentors and trains team and cross functional groups as required (induction, GMP etc)

• Subject matter expert to internal & external regulatory requirements, (including but not limited to European RHQ, Division, Corporate, FDA, ISO, MDD, and individual country regulatory requirements)

• Subject matter expert to multi-siye / global procedures, contribute to the development, maintenance and improvements of the policies and procedures to align to best practices, benchmarking against industry leads and regulatory requirements. Input / BPO to corporate documents.

• Coach, mentor and train other functions in area of sterility and monitoring.

• Support of, ensure compliance of new products to sites’ sterility standards. Ensure successful integration of products into validated processes.

• Oversight & approval of biocompatible assessments of components, materials and consumables used in the manufacture of Stryker product.

• Provides Technical Assessment for completion of Risk Assessment for SofHA in area of sterility and microbiology. Assessment and approval of acceptance of resolution to quality issues including concession management.

• Demonstrate technical supervisory capabilities and leads projects to completion.

Qualification Knowledge Skills

• Bachelor degree Microbiology or equivalent/ related subject required, with 6 years Microbiology related experience

• Minimum of 8 years in Quality/Regulatory Affairs environment.

• Experience in interacting with regulatory agencies (FDA, MoH, TUV, etc.) required.

• Lead auditor certification desirable.

• Thorough knowledge and understanding of US and International Medical Device Regulations and standards in area of expertise (Microbiology)

• Must possess strong communication, project management and influencing skills as well as have the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Knowl
